protocolMetadata.instructions:
Read-only AliExpress server (market FR, EUR). 8 tools; none writes, orders and payments are blocked.
Pass the whole list in one call, never loop. A rating or review count of 0 from AliExpress means unknown (null, listed in z): get_reviews is authoritative.
- get_products: 1-10 products, compact; with:[skus,freight,reviews,age,wholesale,media,description,raw]; compare:true for 2-8 copies.
- get_sku_matrix: variants, true labels (sku_attr after '#'), EUR price, stock.
- get_freight: shipping per SKU; fee_eff = fee paid at the SKU price; without sku_ids it reads the SKUs 20 at a time.
- get_media_snapshot: supplier media inventory; receipt_urls gives byte receipts; view shows up to 8 images to you.
- search_text, search_by_image: find products and other suppliers of the same product.
- get_reviews: summaries for 1-10 products, or pages of one.
- aliexpress_call: any other read-only AliExpress method; method "docs" for the official spec, "status" for token and quota.
compact:true gives columnar answers with the same facts. An answer with next was cut by the per-call budget: call again with next. On error follow next_step, retry once, then report.

tool.name: aliexpress_call
tool.description: Read-only escape hatch: signs and calls any AliExpress method not covered above. method "docs" (params {q} or {method}) returns the official spec; "status" the token, quota and cache state. Orders, payments, token and write methods are refused before signing. Answers unwrap *_response and list wrappers, keep request_id and empty strings, replace description HTML by a marker; pick paths like "result.ae_item_sku_info_dtos[].sku_attr"; over max_chars, too_large gives the size of each key instead of cutting.

_published_faq.name: How do I add atl-aliexpress to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add atl-aliexpress to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://atl-aliexpress-mcp.latelierdulustre.workers.dev/mcp/d5c71c35cf20835eb60e05644aaa18c09e08c277452de577.

_published_faq.name: Is atl-aliexpress MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 14, 2026, atl-aliexpress scores 94/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is atl-aliexpress's MCP tool documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 14, 2026, atl-aliexpress scores 56/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 8 of 8 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to atl-aliexpress?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to atl-aliexpress in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.

_published_faq.name: How can atl-aliexpress improve its MCP documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: search_by_image is the lowest-scoring reviewed tool at 51/100. No output schema is declared. Add one for structured results so clients can interpret returned fields. Open its review for feedback and a copyable fix prompt, then rerun the documentation review after updating your tool metadata.
